rule.dataset: COG-BCI, N-back (0/1/2) and MATB (easy/med/diff), all sessions, LOSO over all participants
rule.frozen: architecture and hyper-parameters copied from CMx7 (no tuning on COG-BCI)
rule.H-N1a: task-invariant training helps when task and workload are crossed: C (TCAI) > A (no adversary), LOSO fold balanced accuracy, one-sided Wilcoxon over test subjects, Holm over the two backbones (EEGNet, graph), p < 0.05
rule.H-N1b: TCAI vs plain GRL: theory predicts C ~ B under a balanced crossed design; reported with a 95% CI, no directional claim
rule.H-N1c: C carries less task information than A: task probe on validation embeddings, one-sided Wilcoxon over folds, p < 0.05
rule.N1 verdict: SUPPORTED = H-N1a and H-N1c on the same backbone; PARTLY = one of them; NOT SUPPORTED = neither
rule.H-M: proposed model generalises to a second dataset: final model v2 and Graph A vs EEGNet, two-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the two; claim only if delta > 0 and p_Holm < 0.05
rule.design check: task-only lookup must be near chance (crossed design)
rule.recent models: ShallowConvNet, EEG-Conformer, CBraMod (probe / fine-tune) with library defaults: reported on the same folds; final model v2 vs each recent model with Holm (two-sided, descriptive -- no direction pre-specified)
